submitted.body: Built-in browser recheck at d73e407: both the existing GLM QA session and a fresh GLM child returned 'Unknown tool browser.tabs.list'. Session permissions show the Muse tester has its own browser:* grant while both GLM sessions have none. OpenCode's browser plugin revokes a child's inherited grant at prompt time and requires a desktop attachment for that child, so retrying cannot attach it. The GLM built-in pass remains BLOCKED; the labelled Chrome fallback result stands. WI-050 and Sprint-6 stay in review until the owner opens the GLM QA session (ses_de511deb9ffevPHhHeaGkMjBse) in the desktop with its browser pane, or supplies a top-level GLM session. Evidence: agents/qa/WI-050/browser-access.md.
